system.description:
Lore: Relic Chest

An abracadabrus never runs in the same family twice - the ones that survive tend to end up in the hands of merchants clever enough not to ask for soup twice in one day.

A gemstone-studded chest with a 1.5-foot cubic interior. It has 5 charges, all of which return after a Rest. As an Action, touch the closed lid and spend 1 charge while naming one or more nonmagical objects worth 1g or less total - they appear inside, provided they fit and the chest is otherwise empty. Food and drink conjured this way are delicious but spoil after 24 Hours; conjured gems or precious metals crumble to nothing after 1 Minute.

It has the following Powers:

  • Cornucopia: 5 charges, all of which return after a Rest. Spend a charge to conjure nonmagical items worth up to 1g in total inside the chest - food, drink, rope, kindling. Conjured matter vanishes after a Rest.

Value: 4000g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)
